items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: that Herb Rose. He had Tatum, everybody in there. I played intermission piano for Tatum in there!

ctx.x: Oh, that guy used to scream about that, that Herb Rose. He had Tatum, everybody in there. I played intermission piano for Tatum in there! Do you believe that? I used to sit outside. I wouldn't go in. I would wait for the streetcar to take me home, and he'd drag me in there and make me play while Art was taking a vacation at intermission.

So then that one folded some way, and I went over to play up at some joint that Tatum used to play. That's where I met Art. And things progressed, and I'd take jobs and worked here and there, around town. And I was becoming pretty well-known, you know... "That new guy that's in town, that guy with the rosy cheeks, he plays pretty good." So this and that, and I was workin'...
